title: Header of a page of rules
description: The YAML front matter every page of rules starts with. This file is the one place that names the allowed values.

title.description: The title of the page, on one line.

summary.description: One sentence on one line that says what the page decides.

applies-to.description: What the page applies to: all, or one or more specific values. A further value is added to the enum by the pull request that adds the first page needing it.

kind.description: binding: the rules must be followed. informative: the page explains and does not bind.
